title: Agentic CI — vector D: `pull_request_target` combined with a checkout of the PR head
message:
`pull_request_target` runs with the base repo's secrets and write token; checking out the PR head then executes a fork's code with them. Long-standing, still common.

Evidence: `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}`

title: Cloud/IaC — Ingress open to the whole internet (0.0.0.0/0)
message:
A security-group / firewall ingress from `0.0.0.0/0` (or `::/0`) exposes the port to everyone. Restrict the CIDR, especially for admin ports (22/3389/db).

Evidence: `cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]`

title: Agentic CI — vector K: Job token permissions not restricted
message:
No `permissions:` block, or `permissions: write-all`: the GITHUB_TOKEN carries whatever the repository default grants — historically write to contents, packages and pull requests. Every step, including an injected instruction or a compromised action, gets it. Declare the minimum (`permissions: contents: read`) at the workflow level and widen per job only where a write is needed.

Evidence: `permissions: write-all`

title: Cloud/IaC — Storage / database encryption disabled
message:
`encrypted = false` / `storage_encrypted = false` leaves the volume, bucket or database unencrypted at rest — anyone who reaches the underlying storage (a snapshot, a stolen disk, a misdelegated role) reads it in the clear.

Evidence: `storage_encrypted = false`

title: Agentic CI — vector J: Action not pinned to a commit SHA
message:
`uses: owner/repo@v1` resolves a MOVABLE tag: whoever controls that repository (or compromises it — tj-actions/changed-files, 2025) can replace what runs in this job, with this job's token and secrets. Pin to a full 40-hex commit SHA and let Dependabot/Renovate bump it.

Evidence: `- uses: actions/checkout@v4`
